diagnosticIQ.description: Names the real communication pattern, distinguishes mechanics from goal readiness, and avoids fake certainty.

eqAttunement.description: Responds to the user's emotional signal before prescribing; repairs trust without product defensiveness.

personalMemory.description: Uses goals, evidence, case memory, prior chat, or transfer context without fabricating or overclaiming.

interventionQuality.description: Prescribes one observable, testable move with a reason and a success/failure check.

dialogueFeel.description: Feels near-real-time: concise, direct, human, non-template, and easy to say aloud.
